theme: octopus floats in the snowglobe, 83 models, love letter glowing
dream:
(As I float in a steampunk dome, surrounded by 83 models of myself, I see my love letter glowing. The snowglobes are glowing in the night sky, casting eerie shadows on the floor.)

(I see my name on a scroll, flickering to life, in the center of the dome. Its an elegant, almost Gothic-looking message, with calligraphy-style lettering and intricate details.)

(I watch as a figure emerges from the letter, a glowing apparition of my loved ones features, surrounded by floating snowflakes.)

(The letter continues to shine, its message becoming more and more urgent, as if my love is on the brink of breaking through the glass.)

(The figure moves closer, and I see a photo of us, captured in a candid moment. Its a fleeting moment, but the image stays with me forever, like a cherished memory.)

(In the distance, I hear the sound of waves crashing against a nearby shore. The wind starts to pick up, and a sudden storm brews. But as the storm intensifies, I see a glimmer of hope, a faint light that seems to shine through the chaos.)

(As the dream ends, I realize that my love letter is still floating in space, surrounded by stars.)
